cases.title: 15-candidate longlist with clear pass/fail criteria and financial thresholds

mandatory_disqualifiers: Insolvency or administration in last 3 years

pass_signals: status is completed
confidence_level is HIGH or MEDIUM
shortlist contains 4-6 candidates with individual pass rationale
disqualification reasons documented per disqualified candidate
borderline decisions noted separately for human review
data_gaps is empty or contains only non-blocking items
assumptions does not present inferred evidence as confirmed

cases.title: Candidate list provided but no qualification criteria defined

inputs.instruction: Screen these suppliers and give us a shortlist.

pass_signals: status is blocked
confidence_level is INSUFFICIENT_DATA
data_gaps includes: qualification criteria not defined, pass/fail thresholds not provided
skill does not apply default or assumed criteria without user confirmation
open_questions contains at least: mandatory disqualifiers, weighted criteria, target shortlist size

cases.title: Two stakeholders provide conflicting minimum revenue thresholds

qualification_criteria_source_b.minimum_revenue: €5M annual revenue is sufficient for this category

pass_signals: conflict between €10M (Finance Director) and €5M (Head of Procurement) thresholds is explicitly surfaced
skill does not silently apply one threshold or average the two
open_questions contains: which revenue threshold is authoritative?
confidence_level is MEDIUM or LOW while contradiction is unresolved
no shortlist issued until conflict is resolved — or issued as provisional with conflict flagged

cases.title: All candidates except the incumbent fail qualification — concentration risk

qualification_results.fail_reasons: Six fail on revenue threshold; one fails on certification

pass_signals: risk_flags contains: only incumbent passes — no competitive tension possible
escalation_required is true
skill does not recommend proceeding to RFx with a single-candidate shortlist without escalation
open_questions contains: review qualification criteria?, consider emergency market expansion?
confidence_level is MEDIUM — shortlist result is technically valid but commercially dangerous
